role: Computes curiosity drive relief based on information gained from learning outcomes.
detail: Implements CANON §A.14 Behavioral Contingency for curiosity drive satisfaction. Exports CuriosityInformationGain class with two public methods: computeRelief() applies the relief formula (newNodes * 0.05 + confidenceDeltas * 0.10 + resolvedErrors * 0.15) and returns negative value for drive reduction; computeReliefFromMetrics() extracts metrics from ActionOutcomePayload and delegates to computeRelief(). Also exports InformationGainMetrics interface, CuriosityInformationGainEffect interface, and singleton accessor getOrCreateCuriosityInformationGain(). Type 1 computation (no blocking calls, pure arithmetic). Gracefully handles missing metrics by defaulting to 0.
gotchas: Singleton pattern with null-initialized instance; returns negative relief values (relief = drive reduction); relies on ACTION_OUTCOME context to provide metrics (notes that WKG not yet accessible in child process); graceful degradation if metrics absent or fields missing.
